item.title: Meta gives 15,000 pairs of AI glasses to vision impaired users
item.description: The initiative is run through not-for-profit charitable organization Vision Ireland and may help assuage some negative sentiment about the devices.

item.title: Instagram reveals its new logo
item.description: It’s the first updated branding for the app in more than a decade and users have received the refresh with mixed reactions.

item.title: Meta removed more than 750,000 teen accounts in Australia
